blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Reigning Most Valuable Player Dave Ildefonso showed why he remains the man to beat as defending champion Abra Solid North Weavers opened their title-retention bid with a 73-59 victory over the Quezon Huskers in Game One of the Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League (MPBL) 2026 Season National Finals on Tuesday night at the packed Gov. Andres Bernos Memorial Gymnasium in Bangued, Abra. Ildefonso spearheaded Abra’s wire-to-wire victory with a game-high 26 points, including four triples, while Jafe Figueroa came alive in the fourth quarter, scoring all seven of his points in the payoff period to help the Weavers […]...
